lines.en: Tiny infinitesimal, so small it makes you doubt.
lines.zh: 它们非常小，微乎其微，小到让你怀疑。

lines.en: But if you meet a Fixie, please, Don't let their secret out!
lines.zh: 但如果你遇到了修理工，千万别泄露他们的秘密！

lines.en: The Thermometer
lines.zh: 温度计

lines.en: I can't believe the new thermometer isn't working.
lines.zh: 我简直不敢相信新的温度计居然坏了。

lines.en: Tom Thomas, stay in bed. And I'll try and look for...
lines.zh: 汤姆·托马斯，待在床上

lines.en: that old mercury thermometer. Hey! Did you get sick?
lines.zh: 我去找找那个旧的水银温度计。嘿，你生病了吗？

lines.en: That's one way of saying it.
lines.zh: 这是一种说法。

lines.en: I don't know how I'm gonna pass that math test today.
lines.zh: 我不知道我今天怎么才能通过数学考试。

lines.en: You're not ready, so you don't want to go to school.
lines.zh: 你还没准备好，所以你不想去上学。

lines.en: Well, yeah. So if you pull a sickie, then you can trick your mom!
lines.zh: 是啊，所以如果你弄个粘粘的，你就可以骗过你妈妈。

lines.en: No, that's not true. I'm just pretending a little bit.
lines.zh: 不，那不是真的，我只是稍微假装一下。

lines.en: You think so?
lines.zh: 你这么想？好吧

lines.en: Well, you won't trick the thermometer!
lines.zh: 你骗不了温度计。

lines.en: Simka, what's a mercury thermometer?
lines.zh: 辛卡，什么是水银温度计？

lines.en: Mercury is a type of liquid metal that's silver in color.
lines.zh: 水银是一种银色的液态金属。

lines.en: There's no mercury inside of new thermometers, now they're electronic.
lines.zh: 现在的新温度计里没有水银了。

lines.en: Old thermometers were made with a glass tube
lines.zh: 老式电子体温计是用一根带有刻度的玻璃管做的

lines.en: with markings and a bit of mercury inside them.
lines.zh: 里面装着一小管水银。

lines.en: When the end of the tube warms up,
lines.zh: 当管子末端受热时

lines.en: the mercury inside of it expands and creeps up the tube.
lines.zh: 里面的水银会膨胀并沿着管子向上移动

lines.en: And that's how those old thermometers measure temperature.
lines.zh: 这就是老式体温计测量温度的原理。

lines.en: The longer the column of mercury, the higher the person's temperature is.
lines.zh: 水银柱越长，体温越高。

lines.en: That means I need to warm up the end of the thermometer.
lines.zh: 这意味着我需要加热体温计的末端。

lines.en: Tom Thomas, you're a genius!
lines.zh: 汤姆·托马斯，你真是个天才！

lines.en: But how will you warm it up?
lines.zh: 但是你要怎么加热呢？

lines.en: Finally, I found it. Well, let's see. Mom, can I eat something?
lines.zh: 我终于找到了！嗯，让我想想。妈妈，我可以吃点东西吗？

lines.en: Hang in there, sweetie. I'll make you something.
lines.zh: 宝贝，坚持住，我给你做点吃的。

lines.en: Ooh, that is hot!
lines.zh: 现在很烫！

lines.en: Now there's just no way it won't have a temperature.
lines.zh: 它肯定有温度了。

lines.en: Hey, what are you doing in here? Well, how high did you get it?
lines.zh: 嘿，你在这里干什么？

lines.en: A hundred eight is what it's showing. Oh no!
lines.zh: 你测到多高了？显示108度。

lines.en: With a temperature that high it will send you straight to the hospital,
lines.zh: 哦不，这么高的温度，他们会直接把你送到医院的

lines.en: and you don't need that.
lines.zh: 你可不想那样。

lines.en: You'd better shake that thermometer.
lines.zh: 你最好摇晃一下体温计。

lines.en: Yeah, that's what I'll do. That will get the temperature down a little.
lines.zh: 对，我这就摇，这样温度就能降下来一点。

lines.en: Well, so much for that! Cheaters never prosper!
lines.zh: 好吧，作弊者，永远别想骗我。

lines.en: Tom Thomas! Did you see this?
lines.zh: 普罗斯珀·汤姆·托马斯，你看到了吗？

lines.en: Nolik, don't touch the mercury! It's poisonous!
lines.zh: 不，别碰汞，它有毒！

lines.en: Stop it right now! And you, Tom Thomas, you don't touch that mercury either.
lines.zh: 立刻停下！还有你，汤姆·托马斯，你也别碰汞

lines.en: It's dangerous!
lines.zh: 它很危险！

lines.en: Then how can we throw it out?
lines.zh: 那我们怎么把它扔掉呢？

lines.en: Call your mom and she can help you.
lines.zh: 打电话给你妈妈，她可以帮你。

lines.en: I can't. How could I call her?
lines.zh: 我不能，我怎么能打电话给她？

lines.en: Then she'd find out that I wanted to touch it.
lines.zh: 那样她就会发现我想骗她。

lines.en: It's a tricker. Maybe it's better to tell the truth.
lines.zh: 也许说实话更好。

lines.en: I can't. I can't do it.
lines.zh: 我不能，我做不到。好吧

lines.en: Alright then, it looks like there's no other choice.
lines.zh: 看来没有别的办法了。

lines.en: Nolik, call Papus and Masiya. I'll get them.
lines.zh: 别舔了，打电话给帕普斯和玛西亚，我去叫他

lines.en: And you go back to your room and wait.
lines.zh: 你回房间等着。谢谢

lines.en: Looks like this whole job is done.
lines.zh: 看来这项工作完成了。

lines.en: Not yet. We still need to neutralize this mercury.
lines.zh: 还没完，我们还需要中和这些汞。

lines.en: In everybody's home, there's all sorts of chemicals around.
lines.zh: 每个人家里都有各种各样的化学品

lines.en: They are used for cleaning dishes, clothes, the bathroom, and dealing with pests.
lines.zh: 它们被用来清洁餐具、衣服、浴室，以及处理害虫。

lines.en: And all of these substances can be very harmful to human health.
lines.zh: 所有这些物质都可能对人体健康造成严重危害

lines.en: But some people don't seem to understand this.
lines.zh: 但有些人似乎并不明白这一点。

lines.en: They might use a dangerous spray or a poisonous liquid,
lines.zh: 他们可能会使用危险的喷雾剂或有毒的液体

lines.en: and then forget to wash their hands afterward.
lines.zh: 然后忘记洗手。

lines.en: And then they go and eat, or rub their eyes with their hands.
lines.zh: 然后他们就去吃东西，或者用手揉眼睛

lines.en: That can cause serious damage to their vision or stomachs.
lines.zh: 这会严重损害他们的视力或胃。

lines.en: And never put anything into your mouth that looks like medicine,
lines.zh: 永远不要把任何看起来像药的东西放进嘴里

lines.en: unless your parents or a doctor gave it to you.
lines.zh: 除非是你的父母或医生给你的。

lines.en: And if you ever happen to find something on
lines.zh: 如果你碰巧在地上找到一块看起来像

lines.en: the ground that looks like a piece of candy,
lines.zh: 糖果的东西

lines.en: you must never put it in your mouth!
lines.zh: 千万不要放进嘴里

lines.en: You can get poisoned that way! Oh, humans!
lines.zh: 那样会中毒的。哦，人类啊

lines.en: If they'd only remember this simple advice, they'd stay safer.
lines.zh: 如果他们能记住这些简单的建议，他们就会更安全。我们该怎么处理

lines.en: And what do we do with the glass that's broken?
lines.zh: 碎玻璃？

lines.en: That job's not for Fixies!
lines.zh: 那可不是我们这些修车工该干的。

lines.en: Tom Thomas, we cleaned up all the mercury!
lines.zh: 汤姆·托马斯

lines.en: And the glass, too?
lines.zh: 我们也把玻璃里的水银都清理干净了。

lines.en: No, not the broken glass. But will you?
lines.zh: 不，不是碎玻璃。但是你能吗？

lines.en: Papus said that it's not our job.
lines.zh: 爸爸说那不是我们的工作。

lines.en: He told us you have to get your parents to come and help you.
lines.zh: 他告诉我们，你得让你的父母来帮你

lines.en: That part's your responsibility.
lines.zh: 那是你的责任。给你点

lines.en: Here's some food for you. What's the matter?
lines.zh: 吃的。怎么了

lines.en: Mom, I… I broke the thermometer. Broken?
lines.zh: 妈妈？我把体温计弄坏了。弄坏了。

lines.en: Did you cut yourself? No. The mercury.
lines.zh: 你割伤自己了吗？没有，是水银。

lines.en: Did you touch it? I didn't.
lines.zh: 你碰过它吗？我没有。

lines.en: Simka, you think he'll tell her the truth?
lines.zh: 辛卡，你觉得你会告诉她真相吗？

lines.en: And where did you break it? The bathroom.
lines.zh: 你在哪里弄坏的？浴室。

lines.en: Why did you go in there? I wanted...
lines.zh: 你为什么进去？

lines.en: I wanted to trick you.
lines.zh: 我想…… 想骗你

lines.en: I have a test, and I didn't study for it.
lines.zh: 我有个考试，但我没复习

lines.en: And now it's too late for school!
lines.zh: 现在上学也来不及了。我昨天差点就抓到一个了。
